item.title: GreyScale-DeadZone #greyscale #deadzone #duos #cs10
item.description: video upload by "This work uses a runaway noise generator from Hikari Instruments / Duos as the main source. This extreme signal was passed through the external input of the legendary 1970s Yamaha CS-10, and then thoroughly deconstructed and reconstructed using filter modulation.
